competences.description: Attacks the enemy with razor-sharp claws. Damage increases accordingly to your Attack Speed.
Attacks the enemy with a body slam and weakens their Attack Power and Defense for 2 turns. After the attack, your Attack Bar increases by 30% for each harmful effect granted on the enemy target.
Pursuits the enemy to inflict damage that's proportionate to your MAX HP and Attack Speed. The damage increases by 15% for each harmful effect on the enemy.
